patch.author: martinhochel@microsoft.com
patch.comment: Prepare the first 0.0.1 release of React Compiler Analyzer: analyze and lint workflows, guided initialization with an optional repository Agent Skill, schema-validated shared configuration, opt-in runtime-risk detection, first-party wrapper and wildcard path-alias resolution, directive fixes and risk-aware annotations, and CLI/Markdown/HTML reports with foldable HTML navigation. Harden parse, configuration, and compiler failure handling, including unattributed lint diagnostics; keep generated bailout comments on one line without swallowing compact function bodies; preserve file-level opt-outs and directives whose probes fail; resolve default exports, imported exports, and lexical call bindings; recognize all JavaScript line endings and actual directive comments; exclude dependencies and declarations by default; validate integer concurrency; escape Markdown table cells and normalize JSON diagnostic paths; require Node.js ^22.14.0 or ^24.0.0; emit canonical JSON v2 results; and detect nested memo/forwardRef migration candidates while preserving custom comparators. Include a human-facing CLI reference, packaged technical guides, and versioned migration notes from experimental builds.
